WITH ticket_agg AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, agent_group_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_agent_id IS NULL) AS unassigned_count,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_response_at - created_at))/60.0) FILTER (WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_first_response_minutes,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/60.0) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_resolution_minutes
  FROM tickets
  WHERE agent_group_id IS NOT NULL
    AND created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id, agent_group_id
),
breach_agg AS (
  SELECT t.tenant_id, t.agent_group_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sb.ticket_id) AS resolution_breach_count
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN sla_breaches sb ON sb.ticket_id = t.id AND sb.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  WHERE t.agent_group_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND sb.breach_kind = 'resolution'
  GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.agent_group_id
),
agent_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, agent_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT support_agent_id) AS agent_count
  FROM agent_group_members
  GROUP BY tenant_id, agent_group_id
)
SELECT
  ten.name AS tenant_name,
  ag.name AS agent_group_name,
  ta.ticket_count,
  COALESCE(ac.agent_count,0) AS agent_count,
  ROUND(ta.ticket_count::numeric / NULLIF(ac.agent_count,0), 1) AS tickets_per_agent,
  ROUND(100.0 * ta.unassigned_count / NULLIF(ta.ticket_count,0), 1) AS pct_unassigned,
  ROUND(ta.avg_first_response_minutes::numeric, 1) AS avg_first_response_minutes,
  ROUND(ta.avg_resolution_minutes::numeric, 1) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ba.resolution_breach_count,0) / NULLIF(ta.ticket_count,0), 1) AS resolution_breach_rate
FROM ticket_agg ta
JOIN tenants ten ON ten.id = ta.tenant_id
JOIN agent_groups ag ON ag.id = ta.agent_group_id
LEFT JOIN agent_counts ac ON ac.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND ac.agent_group_id = ta.agent_group_id
LEFT JOIN breach_agg ba ON ba.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND ba.agent_group_id = ta.agent_group_id
ORDER BY ta.ticket_count DESC, ten.name, ag.name
LIMIT 20

- **Measures:** ticket_count, agent_count (distinct agents via `agent_group_members`), tickets_per_agent, pct_unassigned, avg_first_response_minutes, avg_resolution_minutes, resolution_breach_rate — all from `tickets`, `agent_groups`, `agent_group_members`, `support_agents`, `tenants`, and `sla_breaches`, windowed on `tickets.created_at` in 2025 with `agent_group_id` not null, as requested.
